article_content: A ComRes poll for ITV News shows Ukip leading with 38% support among decided voters in the May 22 European elections, outpacing Labour (27%) and Conservatives (18%). The party secures majority backing in key English regions: 53% in the Eastern constituency and 52% in the West Midlands, though remains weaker in Wales (29% vs Labour's 36%) and Scotland (12%). Ukip leader Nigel Farage declined to contest the Newark by-election created by Patrick Mercer's resignation, stating preference to concentrate on European elections. Public perception remains polarized: 32% perceive Ukip as racist, yet 34% approve its policies. Notably, 48% of 2010 Tory voters find Ukip's policies credible. Despite strong EU poll positions, only 55% of Ukip voters commit to supporting the party in the 2015 general election, contrasting with 90% Labour and 88% Conservative voter loyalty.

article_content: Ambulance transports of patients over 90 to emergency departments rose 80% between 2009/10 (165,910) and 2013/14 (300,370), driven by reduced homecare availability and inadequate GP oversight. Total A&E visits reached 21.7 million last year, with over-90s showing disproportionate growth. Critics cite £2bn social care funding shortfalls since 2010, while Health Secretary Jeremy Hunt advocates assigning dedicated GPs to seniors. Concurrently, 20-24 year-olds account for 8.6% of attendances, double the rate of 70-74 year-olds, attributed to digital-savvy generations expecting immediate care access.

Tai yra dėl mažesnio namų priežiūros paslaugų skaičiaus ir gydytojų neįgalios stebėtinos. Viso akutinėje priežiūroje 2013/14 metais susirinko 21,7 milijonas žmonių. Seniaujantiesiems labiausiai kelia nerimą ilgalaikių ligų valdymo problemos. Sveikatos politikos ekspertai nurodo, kad nuo 2010 m. namų priežiūros finansavimas sumažėjo 2 mln. £, o ministerius Jeremy Hunt siūlo priskirti kiekvienam vyresniems asmenims asmenybę gydytoją. Netrukusiausiu metu didžiausią akutinės priežiūros skyrių prekę sudaro 20-24 metų asmenys (8,6%), kurie laukiama greitesnės diagnozės, o 70-74 metų grupė turi tik 3,5%. Šis tenderis rodo jaunesnes kartų įprastumą reikalauti greito atsakymo.

article_content: A federal appeals court has temporarily suspended Arizona's stringent abortion law prohibiting procedures after 20 weeks of pregnancy. The 9th Circuit Court placed key provisions of HB 2036 on hold while accelerating legal proceedings, overturning an earlier district court decision. This controversial measure, signed into law by Governor Jan Brewer, allows abortions only when continuing the pregnancy would cause severe harm or death to the pregnant individual. Advocacy groups successfully argued that the law would force doctors to delay life-saving interventions until patients reached critical condition. While 10 states have enacted similar gestational limits, Arizona's version uniquely bars termination in cases where the fetus lacks viability. The court's expedited review process signals recognition of the urgent constitutional questions raised by such restrictions.

Skubus teisinis tyrimas rodo, kad tokie apribojimai kelia svarbias etines problemas. Patvirtintas įstatymas skiriasi nuo kitų valstijų, nes draudžia operacijas netgi tada, kai baltelis negali gyventi išskirtos. Gydytojai ir teisėbybos grupės tęsia kovą už sveikesnę medicinos politiką.

article_content: England head coach Stuart Lancaster has prioritized results over developmental goals by recalling veteran Nick Easter and Danny Cipriani to the Six Nations squad. 'The team cycle has reached a point where development stops - it's about winning,' Lancaster declared. This strategic shift sees Easter, absent since the 2011 World Cup, return at 36 following Ben Morgan's injury. The decision reflects confidence in proven performers despite Easter's historical ties to past controversies. Forward coach Graham Rowntree praised Easter's sustained performance levels, noting his physical preparedness remains impressive. Midfield choices remain debated, with Brad Barritt and Luther Burrell selected ahead of younger options. Lancaster emphasized disciplinary concerns after captain Dylan Hartley's recent suspension, warning avoidable penalties could jeopardize Wales match plans. Balancing World Cup ambitions with cultural integrity, England's selectors prioritize match-winning experience while maintaining recent team-building efforts.

Easteras, kuris per 2011 m. pasaulio čempionatą patyrė nesėkmes, dabar parodo geriausią formą, todėl gavo galimybę grįžti. Treniravimo komanda įvertino Eastero fizinę pagamytumą, nors jis jau 36 metai. Centrinėje pozicijoje yra pasirinkę stabili Bradas Barritas ir Luteris Burrellas, o Dilonas Hartlis turi geriau kontroliuoti savo veiksmus. Anglijos strategija atspindi prioritetą padaryti svarbius laimėjimus, o ne tik kurti komandinę kultūrą.

article_content: Elizabeth 'Elle' Edmunds, 31, falsely claimed a terminal ovarian cancer diagnosis to secure donations, later stating she truly believed she was dying due to psychological issues. The Lake Macquarie mother-of-six's deception devastated her partner John Heaghney and children after he exposed the fraud. Though no cancer existed, she purchased pills online to simulate chemotherapy. Community fundraisers raised significant sums, which organizers now demand be repaid. Critics accuse her of exploiting public sympathy for genuine cancer sufferers, with one donor describing her actions as 'morally reprehensible.' Mental health professionals note such behavior can stem from unresolved trauma, though this does not excuse the financial exploitation.

Šios tėtos šešių vaikų netikrumas sugriovė jos partnerį Johną Heaghenį ir šeimą, kai jis atskleidė tiesę. Nors canceris neturėjo būti, ji pirko internete chemoterapijos imitacijai naudojamus medicinos produktus. Visuomenės iniciatyvos surinko daugybę lėšų, kurias dabar reikalauja grąžinti. Kritikai kritiko, kad naudojosi visuomenės pagalbos gynantiems tikrųjų ligoniams, vienas padavėjas aprašė joją kaip 'moraliai netinkamą'. Psichologai pastebėjo, kad tokie atvejai gali susiję su nesugalintu traumos, nors tai neatleista finansiškos pažeidžiamosios.

article_content: The Arabian Desert, linking three continents, harbors specialized wildlife. The Arabian Partridge, a poorly understood endemic species, saw its first population study in Saudi Arabia's Harrat Uwayrid Biosphere Reserve after expanding its range northward. Researchers documented ~118 individuals in rocky terrain, noting threats from illegal hunting (present in 25% of surveyed areas) and feral donkeys (linked to 23x lower bird density). Conservation actions proposed include enhanced law enforcement and invasive species management to protect this climate-vulnerable species.

Nauja studija apie neriboto gyvenimo Arabų kepę, atrastą Saudo Arábijos Harrat Uwayrid biosferos rezervatyre, rodo, kad 118 gyvūnų gyvena skersmeninėse vietoje. Neteisėta medžioklė (25 % vietovėse) ir netikėtos asinys (23 kartus mažesnis gyvūnų skaičius) yra pagrindiniai pavojai. Rekomenduojama stiprinti apsaugos priemones, pvz., netikėtų rūšių valymą ir įstatymų laikymasis, kad išsaugotume šią rūšį.

article_content: Former kidnapper John Esposito, 64, died in his Sing Sing prison cell following a parole review, ending his 15-to-life term for the 1992 abduction of 9-year-old Katie Beers. Found unresponsive due to natural causes under investigation, his death sparked mixed reactions from the survivor. Katie Beers, now a married mother of two, stated: 'Though I grieve for his family, justice ensures he cannot reoffend.' Her memoir reveals enduring trauma from both Esposito's captivity and prior childhood abuse by her godmother's husband. The case gained renewed attention as parallels emerged with the Ariel Castro case weeks earlier. Beers credits her ordeal with saving her from escalating familial neglect, enabling her eventual academic and career success despite ongoing emotional challenges.

Jis mirė Sing Sing gerkinėje po paroliavimo klausymo, o mirties priežastis laikoma natūralia. Katie Beers, dabar 30 metų, motina du vaikams, pasakydavusi: 'Nors džiaugiuosi, kad jis negalės keliauti žalos, visgi džiaugiuosi, kad jis negalės keliauti žalos.' Jos autobiografija apima ne tik įkaltinimo, bet ir ankstyvųjų vaikystės pažeidimų, kuriuos sukelė jos tevinės saugotojos vyras. Jos svarstymas su Arielu Castro atveju parodyja, kaip tokių veiksnių sąvoka tampa šokiančia visuomenei.
